heading: `BetaNode` atom
text:
## `BetaNode` atom [RDSC.4a.7]

One beta (join) node.

Proto: `proto/beta.proto#BetaNode`.

`left_parent_id == 0` marks a root beta (first or only pattern
in a rule). The loader seeds root betas with a nil token so
that right-activations immediately produce single-fact tokens
at pattern-index 0.

`join_tests` are `Expr` trees evaluated against
`(left_token, right_candidate_fact)`. A VAR node with
`pattern_index = 255` reads from the candidate right fact ([RDSC.4a.9.1]).

`is_negative = true` makes this a NOT node.
